title: Instance backups
description: Create a consistent copy of the database and encryption keys without stopping the instance.
sensitive: Backups contain credentials, session tokens and encryption keys. The ZIP is not encrypted. Store it privately and keep an off-host copy.
created: Backup created. Download a copy for off-host storage.
createFailed: Backup failed or another backup is running. Refresh the list and check the server logs before retrying.
downloadFailed: Download failed. The backup may have expired; refresh the list and try again.
loadFailed: Could not load backups. Refresh to retry.
empty: No backups yet. Create one before upgrading or rotating keys.
retention: Keep the latest {{count}} backups after each successful backup
restoreDescription: Stop the instance first. Restore a trusted archive to a new directory with the matching application image, then switch the data mount. Existing data is never overwritten. Review pending deployments before restarting; restoring the database does not undo external updates.
configuration: Configure scheduling with RELEASETRACKER_BACKUP_INTERVAL_HOURS (0–168; 0 disables it), retention with RELEASETRACKER_BACKUP_RETENTION (1–100), and a protected storage directory with RELEASETRACKER_BACKUP_DIR. Defaults: disabled, 7 copies, backups beside the database.
failing: The last {{count}} backup(s) failed: {{reason}}. Notifiers subscribed to the “error” event were alerted.
overdue: Automatic backups are overdue: the newest successful backup is older than two intervals.

errors.storage_error: Storage error (disk full or directory unavailable)
errors.too_large: Database exceeds the backup size limit
